    bigint.pow(bigint(a), exponent) -
    bigint.pow(bigint(b), exponent)

    for lesser in 1..exponent do
        let smaller = difference(lesser, a, b)
        let common mut =
            bigint.greatest_common_divisor(greatest, smaller)
